where: Rival battles with Wren (Pale Vault, Nightreach, and the post-game rematch)
mood: The rival who grew up beside you — cocky, quick, competitive and fond: a grin across the field, and the friendship under it.
core_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
E minor with a warm turn to G major
cocky bouncy syncopated pulse-wave lead melody
plucked sampled electric bass walking in octaves
sampled snare backbeat and tom fills over a light kick on beats one and three, crash cymbal on each phrase start
competitive rival battle theme, spirited and playful with a heart of friendship

sections.name: Rival Appears
sections.text: {a cocky sampled drum fill on snare and toms with a plucked-bass pickup, then the rival theme kicks in on the downbeat}

sections.name: Rival Theme
sections.text: {the rival hook: a cheeky, bouncy syncopated melody with attitude, answered by brass stabs, the octave bass strutting underneath}

sections.name: Rival Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the hook again with a second lead harmonising a third below, like two friends racing neck and neck, a little faster-feeling}

sections.name: Friendship Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: a warm turn to G major, a heartfelt broad melody over sustained strings and brass, two friends from the same hometown, then a quick drum fill revs back up}

sections.name: Rival Theme Return
sections.text: {back to E minor, the cheeky rival hook at full speed; the last bar is a snappy drum fill leading straight back into the hook}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
